title: Unit contract and evidence
responsibility: Presents a unit’s technical contract, dependencies, budgets and recorded scenario coverage.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.unit
inputs.description: Required unit definition whose ownership, interfaces, dependencies and limits are displayed.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.units
inputs.description: Required surrounding registry, used to resolve dependency relationships and find consumers.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.scenarios
inputs.description: Required scenarios, filtered to those covering this unit.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.records
inputs.description: Required verification records. Prefers a valid passed record, then any valid record, to show measured results and scenario status.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.removed
inputs.description: Optional removed-unit label, defaulting to false. The caller must supply the appropriate historical unit and evidence.

inputs.name: HarnessUnit.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback receiving a dependency or consumer identifier when selected.

outputs.name: HarnessUnit
outputs.description: Ownership and interface details; dependencies and consumers; runtime, source, emitted-size and performance budgets; unprofiled measurements for this unit; and scenario requirements, exemptions, viewports, tests and recorded outcomes. Scenarios without a selected record remain not tested.
